# bioexcel/biobb_pmx/pmxcreate_top

## Summary

Wrapper class for the PMX create_top module.

Create a complete ligand topology file from two input topology files.

Nextflow adapter of the [Pmxcreate_top](https://biobb-pmx.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pmx.html#module-pmx.pmxcreate_top) building block of [biobb_pmx](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_pmx) 5.3.0.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_PMX_PMXCREATE_TOP } from 'bioexcel/biobb_pmx/pmxcreate_top'

workflow {
    BIOBB_PMX_PMXCREATE_TOP(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_topology1_path` | yes | itp | Path to the input topology file 1 |
| `input_topology2_path` | yes | itp | Path to the input topology file 2 |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_topology_path` | yes | zip | Path to the complete ligand topology file |
| `versions_biobb_pmx` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_pmx', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of Pmxcreate_top properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_topology_path: 'zip']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_pmx container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_PMX_PMXCREATE_TOP' {
        ext.properties = [force_field: 'amber99sb-star-ildn-mut.ff']
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `force_field` | string | "amber99sb-star-ildn-mut.ff" | Force-field to be included in the generated topology. |
| `water` | string | "tip3p" | Water model to be included in the generated topology. |
| `system_name` | string | "Pmx topology" | System name to be included in the generated topology. |
| `mols` | array | "[[Protein,1],[Ligand,1]]" | Molecules to be included in the generated topology. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
